properties.evidence: The question grew into this requirement and shipped in v0.59.0. It asked WHERE the log should live and recommended option (1), beside the store rather than in the graph; the built ledger is at `<graph-path>.usage.jsonl`, beside the store, with a test literally named `a_torn_line_is_skipped_and_the_ledger_sits_beside_the_store`. It also argued a TOOL is the wrong shape because a tool must be called and the population worth measuring is the one least likely to call it — the server records every call without the agent's cooperation, which is what shipped. Drawn 2026-09-14 during a sweep for open questions whose answers already shipped: nobody drew it at promotion time, which is why the question still reads open.
